I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

It's a 1280px screen inside `#component`, with plain HTML and CSS only. It follows the v4 Screens rules in `DESIGN.md`:
- **Page:** white background, one centered column at most 1120px wide, with 48px above and 32px side padding.
- **Top row:** "Team" on the left in Unbounded Light capitals, with the ink pill "Invite Member" on the right.
- **Members:** one card holds the five members. Each row is 52px tall with a divider, showing name, email and a 44px role select (Admin, Editor, Viewer) with the right role preselected.
- **Tokens and rules:** every colour, size, radius and tracking value comes from a token. I pasted the needed tokens into the file so it stands alone. There are no hex values in the component styles, and the select's chevron is drawn in CSS.

I added a few things beyond your content. They are:
- Column headers (Name, Email, Role) in the label style, since the table rule asks for a header row.
- Small initials avatars next to each name.
- An `aria-label` on each select.

Unbounded and Archivo aren't in the folder, so the file uses the fallback fonts listed in the tokens. The type will look different until those fonts are available.
